name: Rio de Janeiro
tagline: Mountains, beaches and a spectacular skyline
summary: Build Rio around clear-weather viewpoints and neighbourhood time. Plan transport between areas and keep beach walks and evening outings situationally aware.
seasonNote: Summer is hot, humid and busy around Carnival; cooler months can suit sightseeing. Visibility governs mountain views.
arrival: GIG has a long transfer to the beach districts; use an official taxi, authorized transfer or a reputable app pickup.
gettingAround: Metro is useful for major districts; use booked rides for uphill sights and late returns.
cashTip: Cards are widely used; keep a small cash reserve and avoid displaying valuables.
foodTip: Try pão de queijo, açaí and a kilo buffet; check meat ingredients and portion charges.
buyTip: Look for locally made beachwear and crafts; compare quality at the Ipanema Sunday fair.
baseArea: Ipanema or Copacabana near a Metro station.

connections.note: Approximate air time; international check-in and transfers extra.

connections.mode: Flight to Foz do Iguaçu + border transfer
connections.note: Allow additional time for the Brazil–Argentina border; check entry requirements.

reviewSummary: The visitor listings repeatedly feature the major mountain viewpoints, beaches and museums; CCBB has a verified indexed 4.7/5 snapshot with 8,694 reviews.

items.name: Christ the Redeemer
items.summary: The Corcovado statue and terrace overlook the city’s mountain-and-bay setting.
items.expect: Popular timed transport and a crowded summit platform; clouds can erase the view.
items.tip: Book through an official transport channel and choose a clear-weather window if possible.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate for official return transport and monument access; fares vary.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The statue places a recognisable Art Deco monument above Rio’s mountain-and-bay landscape.
The summit view connects beaches, dense neighbourhoods and forested slopes in one panorama.
visitFlow: Choose official timed transport and a suitable weather window.
Visit the statue terrace and work around the viewpoints patiently.
items.tradeoffs: Popular timed transport and a crowded summit platform; clouds can erase the view.

items.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
items.summary: Two cable-car stages reveal Guanabara Bay and the city below.
items.expect: Queues build near sunset; wind or weather can affect operations.
items.tip: Allow time to enjoy the intermediate Urca stop, not just the summit.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per adult; check the current official price.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Two cable stages reveal the bay from progressively higher viewpoints.
The intermediate Urca stop gives a different perspective from the summit.
visitFlow: Ride to Urca and explore before continuing.
Leave time for the summit and the return queue.
items.tradeoffs: Queues build near sunset; wind or weather can affect operations.

items.name: Ipanema & Arpoador
items.summary: Walk the beach promenade and watch sunset from Arpoador.
items.expect: An active public beach; sea conditions and crowds change.
items.tip: Carry minimal valuables, use designated swimming areas and respect flag warnings.
items.priceNote: Beach access free; chair, food and drink rentals optional.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Beach, promenade and rocky Arpoador outlook show Rio’s everyday coastal life.
The route can be as short or long as energy and weather allow.
visitFlow: Walk a chosen stretch of promenade with minimal valuables.
Finish at a safe Arpoador viewpoint near sunset if conditions suit.
items.tradeoffs: An active public beach; sea conditions and crowds change.

items.name: Escadaria Selarón
items.summary: A tiled stairway links Lapa and Santa Teresa.
items.expect: Busy photo stops and steep steps.
items.tip: Visit in daylight and use a planned onward route or booked ride.

review.note: Included in the researched destination shortlist; no verified numeric rating snapshot. Open current visitor reviews.

whyVisit: Colourful tiles turn an ordinary staircase into a large public artwork.
The steps visually link the Lapa and Santa Teresa area.
visitFlow: Visit in daylight on a planned route.
Look at a few tile details before taking a photograph without blocking the stairs.
items.bestFor: Public art and a short visual stop
items.tradeoffs: Busy photo stops and steep steps.

review.note: Indexed visitor-rating snapshot; check live reviews for changes.

Visit the chosen galleries and look at the public interior spaces.
items.bestFor: Art and a useful indoor alternative
items.tradeoffs: A good alternative on a rainy day; particular shows may need timed reservations.

items.expect: Counter-service cafés and juice bars have different serving sizes and extras.
items.tip: Ask whether açaí is sweetened and which toppings are included.

items.name: Ipanema Sunday craft fair
items.summary: Browse paintings, leatherwork and souvenirs at Praça General Osório.
items.expect: The main fair is a Sunday activity, not a daily market.
items.tip: Ask about maker and material; keep purchases small enough for your luggage.
items.priceNote: Free to browse; planning allowance for optional purchases.

review.note: Included in the researched destination shortlist; no verified numeric rating snapshot. Open current visitor reviews.

whyVisit: Browse paintings, leatherwork and souvenirs at Praça General Osório.
Comparing several makers or stalls makes it easier to choose something connected to the place.
visitFlow: Browse a small selection before choosing.
Ask about maker and material; keep purchases small enough for your luggage.
items.tradeoffs: The main fair is a Sunday activity, not a daily market.

items.name: Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro
items.summary: Palm avenues, living plant collections and shaded paths below the Tijuca hills.
items.expect: A large botanical garden with uneven paths and humid weather.
items.tip: Official information lists foreign visitor entry separately. Check payment methods before arrival.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The royal-palm avenue gives the garden its unmistakable visual identity.
Different plant collections make a slower nature visit possible without a mountain hike.
visitFlow: Enter through the official visitor entrance.
Walk the palm avenue and choose an orchid, bromeliad or cactus collection.
items.tradeoffs: Outdoor weather matters; bring water and mosquito protection.

items.name: Museu do Amanhã
items.summary: A science museum about humanity and the planet in a dramatic harbourfront building.
items.expect: A contemporary science experience rather than a traditional natural-history collection.
items.tip: Check the official page before setting out.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: No verified numeric snapshot for this exact listing; open current reviews. This is an editorial recommendation, not measured footfall.

whyVisit: Interactive exhibitions focus on environmental and social futures.
Its waterfront architecture and surrounding plaza make it visually memorable before entry.
visitFlow: Reserve a timed entry if needed.
Explore the main exhibition, then walk the waterfront outside.
items.tradeoffs: Exhibitions can be busy; the exterior is a distinct, free experience.

items.name: Parque Lage
items.summary: Woodland paths and an art-school mansion beneath Corcovado.
items.expect: Park access and mansion/café access are different; renovation or events may restrict the interior.
items.tip: Do not assume the Corcovado trail is an easy extension; it is a separate strenuous hike.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate in local currency; confirm the current price and what is included.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The courtyard-and-mountain composition is one of the park’s defining views.
The grounds combine native forest with cultural and art activity.
visitFlow: Explore the signed garden paths.
Check mansion and courtyard access with the art school on the day.
items.tradeoffs: The famous courtyard may be restricted or queued; woodland alone is a different visit.

dayClusters.label: Beach-district food and Sugarloaf
dayClusters.note: Start in Copacabana, then use a booked ride to Urca for a clear-weather cable-car visit. Afternoon/sunset access is popular; book a suitable slot and expect queues.

dayClusters.label: Corcovado and a daylight Lapa stop
dayClusters.note: Book official Corcovado transport first, then transfer to the Selaron steps while it is still daylight. This is a ride between districts, not a single walking trail.

dayClusters.label: Ipanema, crafts and Arpoador sunset
dayClusters.note: Schedule this group on Sunday if the craft fair matters; otherwise treat the fair as unavailable and keep the beach walk. Keep valuables minimal and check swimming flags.

dayClusters.label: A downtown cultural day
dayClusters.note: Use the current CCBB programme for a quieter cultural day or a weather swap. The shortlist leaves the rest of the day open rather than inventing extra attractions.
